ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; no driver account flag (driver never falsely tapped "I'm Here").

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's written statement 'I was on my way when the rider cancelled' is a statement, not a record; and even taken at face value it is consistent with the cancellation — the rider cancelled inside the 3-minute grace window, so no fee can stand under NS-4.

Those clauses govern driver-cancellation no-show claims; here cancelled_by = rider [F2], so NS-0 routes the case to NS-4. Independently, the driver never arrived (1806 m away [F1], driver_arrived_at null [F3]) and never tapped "I'm Here" [F4], so a no-show fee could not be supported anyway.
Band 3 (20–29 km/h) on Boon Lay Way is moderate traffic and no incident was recorded [F12]; it cannot justify any deviation or cancellation charge in this no-show dispute.
